title: Playful Valentine micro-app with multi-screen flow, dodging NO button, and YES celebration

requirements.text: Implement a 4-step, single-page Valentine micro-app flow with clearly separated screens: (1) Intro screen, (2) Build-up screen, (3) Big Question screen, (4) Sweet Ending screen. Navigation must be driven by button clicks and not require any backend calls.

quotes: “Hi Anya 💕 I made a tiny app just to ask you something…”

acceptanceCriteria: App starts on an Intro screen and progresses forward via user actions only (no page reloads required).
The flow includes Intro, Build-up, Big Question, and Sweet Ending screens; Sweet Ending is shown after the YES celebration (or via a clear continue action after YES).
All screen transitions are smooth and feel "gentle" (no harsh flashing or jarring motion).

requirements.text: Create the Intro screen with the exact user-facing text (in English) and a single primary button labeled “Continue”. Text must read: “Hi Anya 💕\nI made a tiny app just to ask you something…”

quotes:
“Hi Anya 💕
I made a tiny app just to ask you something…”

Button:
👉 “Continue”

acceptanceCriteria: Intro screen displays the specified text exactly (including emoji) and a “Continue” button.
Clicking “Continue” moves to the Build-up screen.

requirements.text: Create the Build-up screen with the exact user-facing text (in English) and a single primary button labeled “I’m ready”. Text must read: “This is a very serious question.\nPlease answer honestly 😌”

quotes:
Text:

“This is a very serious question.
Please answer honestly 😌”

Button:
👉 “I’m ready”

acceptanceCriteria: Build-up screen displays the specified text exactly (including emoji) and an “I’m ready” button.
Clicking “I’m ready” moves to the Big Question screen.

requirements.text: Create the Big Question screen with big, bold centered text: “Anya, will you be my Valentine? 💝”. Under it, render two buttons: “YES 💕” and “NO”. Render a small, subtle line of helper text under the buttons: “(Just kidding… but I really hope you say yes 🥺)”.

quotes:
Big bold text in the center:

“Anya, will you be my Valentine? 💝”

Two buttons underneath:

✅ YES 💕

❌ NO

You can even add a tiny line under the buttons:

“(Just kidding… but I really hope you say yes 🥺)”

acceptanceCriteria: Big Question screen shows the question text centered and visually prominent.
Buttons render with labels exactly: “YES 💕” and “NO”.
The helper line appears under the buttons and is visually subtle compared to the main question.

requirements.text: Implement the “dodging NO button” interaction on the Big Question screen: when the user attempts to click/tap the NO button (including pointer hover on desktop and touch/pointer down on mobile), the NO button must evade the pointer by moving (slide/jump) to a new position within a bounded area on the screen. The YES button must remain stationary and easy to click.

quotes:
😏 The Fun Twist (Moving NO Button)

When she tries to tap NO:

The button slides away

Or jumps to a random spot

Or shakes and dodges her finger

The YES button stays still and friendly.

acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to interact with NO (pointerenter/mouseover on desktop, pointerdown/touchstart on mobile, and/or click) causes NO to move away instead of being clicked.
NO’s new position always remains fully visible (not off-screen) and stays within a defined container/bounds.
YES remains fixed in place during NO dodging interactions.
NO behavior does not cause layout shifts that move the question text or YES button.

requirements.text: Show playful, non-pressuring feedback messages near the buttons when NO is dodged. Randomly pick from the provided list and display one at a time, briefly (auto-fade) after each dodge attempt. Messages (English, exactly): “Hey hey hey 😳”, “Nice try”, “That button is shy”, “Wrong choice detected 🚫”, “The universe says no… to NO”.

quotes:
Optional playful messages that appear as she tries:

“Hey hey hey 😳”

“Nice try”

“That button is shy”

“Wrong choice detected 🚫”

“The universe says no… to NO”

acceptanceCriteria: After each NO dodge, one message from the list appears and then disappears automatically.
Messages rotate randomly or pseudo-randomly and do not always repeat the same one.
Message styling matches the app’s cute/playful tone and does not appear aggressive or guilt-inducing.

requirements.text: When the user clicks “YES 💕”, play a celebratory sequence: (1) confetti burst, (2) hearts raining animation, (3) a short vibration on supported devices (use browser vibration API if available). Then show the success message (English, exactly): “Best decision ever 🥰\nHappy Valentine’s Day, Anya ❤️” and the follow-up text: “Dinner / chocolate / cuddles are officially planned 😏”.

quotes:
💥 When She Clicks YES

✨ Confetti explosion
💖 Hearts raining
🎉 Little vibration (if possible)

Message:

“Best decision ever 🥰
Happy Valentine’s Day, Anya ❤️”

Optional follow-up text:

“Dinner / chocolate / cuddles are officially planned 😏”

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking YES triggers a visible confetti effect and a visible hearts-rain effect.
On supported devices, a vibration occurs; on unsupported devices, the app continues without errors.
After the celebration begins, the success message and follow-up text are shown exactly as specified.
After YES is clicked, the NO button is no longer relevant (either hidden/disabled or the screen content changes so it can’t be interacted with).

requirements.text: Add the Sweet Ending screen text (English, exactly): “I promise this app is the only thing that won’t let you say no 😉\nThank you for being you.” Provide a clear, gentle way to reach it after the YES celebration (automatic after a short delay or via a “Continue” button).

quotes:
🥹 Optional Sweet Ending Screen

“I promise this app is the only thing that won’t let you say no 😉
Thank you for being you.”

acceptanceCriteria: Sweet Ending screen displays the specified text exactly (including emoji).
User can reliably reach the Sweet Ending after clicking YES (either automatically after the celebration or via an explicit button).

requirements.text: Apply the requested visual style across all screens: a cute Valentine theme using pink, red, and soft purple; rounded, friendly typography; gentle animations that are not overwhelming. Ensure the overall tone stays playful/cute and not pushy or uncomfortable (e.g., avoid shaming language and keep all microcopy light).

quotes:
🎨 Visual Style

Colors: pink, red, soft purple

Font: rounded, friendly

Animations: gentle, not overwhelming

⚠️ Important Tone Tip

Make sure it feels:
✅ Playful
✅ Cute
❌ Not pushy or uncomfortable

acceptanceCriteria: All screens share a consistent palette (pink/red/soft purple) and rounded, friendly typography.
Animations (screen transitions, message fades, button motions) are smooth and not overly fast or intense.
Copy and interactions feel playful rather than coercive; no additional text beyond what’s specified is added that increases pressure.

requirements.text: Add optional soft romantic background music with an on-screen mute/unmute control that defaults to muted or requires an explicit user action to start playback (to respect browser autoplay policies).
acceptanceCriteria: A mute/unmute (or play/pause) control is visible and works.
Music does not autoplay with sound without a user gesture; initial state is muted or not playing until user interacts.
Toggling audio does not reset the current screen state.

requirements.text: Add generated static visual assets and render them in the UI as part of the theme (served from frontend/public/assets/generated).

quotes:
🎨 Visual Style

Colors: pink, red, soft purple

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames.
At least one generated background/pattern asset is visibly used in the app styling (without harming readability).

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not rely on any external databases or non-Internet-Computer backend services.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutablePaths (compose UI components instead).
nonGoals: Any behavior that attempts to bypass user consent outside the playful NO-button gag (keep tone light and non-coercive).

required: Seamless cute heart pattern background in pink/red/soft-purple palette (valentine-pattern.dim_1600x900.png)
Soft gradient background with subtle bokeh/hearts in pink/red/soft-purple palette (valentine-gradient-bg.dim_1600x900.png)
Minimal rounded heart icon sticker style, soft purple/pink tones (heart-sticker-icon.dim_256x256.png)
